clips.title: The story
paras: On Mulgore’s high mesas, Thunder Bluff shelters the tauren as their capital. Cairne Bloodhoof founded the city after the Third War, bringing a people long scattered across Kalimdor together in a place of refuge and tradition.

Thunder Bluff rises above Mulgore, where rope bridges link its stone mesas and wooden elevators carry travelers up from the plains. For generations, the tauren wandered across central Kalimdor, pursued by centaur raiding parties. During the Third War, Cairne Bloodhoof joined with Warchief Thrall and the New Horde. Together, they drove back the centaurs and claimed Mulgore’s fertile grasslands. Cairne gathered the scattered tribes and founded the city atop the mesas, where the heights offered shelter and a place for the tauren to trade and gather in worship.

Cairne Bloodhoof’s followers share Thunder Bluff with tauren who hold to other ways. Magatha Grimtotem and her kin dwell on the Elder Rise, while spirit walkers and shaman seek the ancestors’ will at the Pools of Vision beneath the city. Tribal rivalries persist, yet Thunder Bluff remains a spiritual pillar of Kalimdor’s Horde. Hunters return from the Barrens, artisans travel through, and druids come to commune with the Earth Mother.
